## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `openai-audio-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Navigate to the API keys dashboard

1. <!-- manual: Open the [OpenAI Platform Dashboard](https://platform.openai.com). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Dashboard › API keys in the left sidebar. -->

## Step 3: Create a new secret key

1. Select **Create new secret key**.
2. Fill in the required details and select **Create secret key**.
3. <!-- manual: Fill in the required details and select Create secret key. -->
4. <!-- manual: Copy the generated API key immediately — it will not be shown again. -->
